hooks.text: 兵、马、象、车被编进肉鸽小队，每枚棋子以独立移动方式和能力承担角色。
hooks.excerpt: Assemble your forces from classic chess pieces including pawns, knights, bishops, rooks, and more. Each piece brings unique movement, abilities, and strategic possibilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 队伍不是可随意补充的棋堆，损失错误的关键棋子会直接改变整局路线。
hooks.excerpt: Every piece matters. Losing the wrong unit can change the entire course of a run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 棋盘、升级和遭遇每局随机重排，玩家要适应一盘不再遵守原规则的残破国际象棋。
hooks.excerpt: No two runs unfold the same way. Randomized boards, randomized upgrades, and unpredictable encounters ensure that every attempt offers new challenges and opportunities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
